column1: What is the CSS math formula used to position floating side rails symmetrically outside a 720px centered container?
column2: left: max(16px, calc((100vw - 720px) / 2 - 70px));

column1: Why is the CSS max() function used when calculating lateral rail offsets from the viewport edge?
column2: It prevents the buttons from being pushed offscreen or overlapping edges when the viewport width is close to the container width.

column1: Why should touch event listeners like touchstart and touchmove use { passive: true }?
column2: It tells the browser the listener will never call preventDefault(), allowing the compositor thread to scroll immediately without waiting for JavaScript execution.

column1: What mathematical condition discriminates an intentional horizontal swipe from a vertical scroll in the modal body touch engine?
column2: Math.abs(dx) >= 45 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.2

column1: How is the horizontal displacement (dx) calculated during a touch gesture lifecycle?
column2: dx = touchEndX - touchStartX;

column1: What does a negative dx (dx < 0) indicate in Cartesian screen coordinate touch tracking?
column2: A swipe gesture moving to the left (finger dragging leftwards towards lower X values).

column1: What does a positive dx (dx > 0) indicate in Cartesian screen coordinate touch tracking?
column2: A swipe gesture moving to the right (finger dragging rightwards towards higher X values).

column1: How does boundary-aware slider touch handling determine when to switch projects instead of slides on a left swipe?
column2: When the user swipes left while state.activeSlideIndex is already at totalSlides - 1 (the last image).

column1: How does boundary-aware slider touch handling determine when to switch projects instead of slides on a right swipe?
column2: When the user swipes right while state.activeSlideIndex is at 0 (the first image).

column1: Why is contains(e.target) checked in the modal body touch listener before handling a case study swipe?
column2: To prevent triggering project navigation when the user is actively swiping inside the image slider component (mediaWrap).

column1: What CSS media query feature ensures desktop lateral rails only display on screens capable of accommodating them?
column2: @media (min-width: 900px)

column1: What CSS transform is used to center an absolutely positioned element vertically at top: 50%?
column2: transform: translateY(-50%)

column1: What CSS property prevents tooltip hover flickers by disallowing mouse interaction on the tooltip element itself?
column2: pointer-events: none;

column1: Why should a tooltip container have white-space: nowrap?
column2: To prevent multi-word titles from wrapping awkwardly into multiple lines inside the floating bubble.

column1: How does the modulo wrap formula ((i - 1) % N + N) % N prevent negative index bugs in JavaScript?
column2: JavaScript's % operator returns negative numbers for negative dividends; adding N and taking % N again guarantees a positive cyclical index in [0, N-1].

column1: What ARIA attribute on the project counter element announces project position changes to screen readers?
column2: aria-live="polite"

column1: Why is shortened CTA text like 'Inquire on WhatsApp' preferred over long text on mobile devices?
column2: It prevents multi-line text wrapping on small viewports, ensuring predictable button height and clean vertical rhythm.

column1: What CSS property creates a frosted-glass blur effect behind a semi-transparent floating button?
column2: backdrop-filter: blur(8px);

column1: What property in TouchEvent.touches contains the horizontal coordinate relative to the browser viewport?
column2: clientX (accessed via e.touches[0].clientX).

column1: Why must touch coordinates be recorded from e.touches[0] during touchmove rather than relying only on touchend?
column2: In touchend, e.touches is empty because the finger has left the screen; the last active coordinate must be cached from touchmove or e.changedTouches[0].

column1: What DOM method is used to query all matching navigation buttons defensively in both single and multi-element environments?
column2: document.querySelectorAll() converted to an array or looped via forEach.

column1: Why are tooltips for lateral rails hidden by default using opacity: 0 and transform instead of display: none?
column2: Animating opacity and transform allows smooth CSS hardware-accelerated transitions on hover, which display: none cannot do.
